concerns.text: FR-004 requires a stratified split by polymer type with class‑distribution deviation ≤ 5 percentage‑points, while the Edge Cases section permits a fallback to a non‑stratified random split when the dataset is too small (< 50 samples). This creates a direct contradiction: the functional requirement disallows non‑stratified splits, yet the edge‑case handling explicitly allows them under certain conditions.
